title: Funny Fantasy Football Loser Flag — Last Place Punishment
description:
Product summary
A loud, direct punishment flag designed to make your league’s last-place manager a good‑natured target at draft parties, watch parties, end‑of‑season events, or in their workspace.

How the flag reads (no changes to the printed lines):
Eyebrow: LAST PLACE CERTIFIED
I SUCK AT
FANTASY
FOOTBALL
Footer: ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE

Design and intent
- Bold, high‑contrast blue background with bright orange accents for a stadium-scoreboard look. Large stacked type for maximum visibility from across a room or yard. Intended as a funny, competitive, good‑natured humiliation for the league loser.
- Use cases: draft day, toilet bowl, end of season, league party, gag gift.

Verified product facts
- Double-sided: phrase printed on both sides.
- Suitable indoors or outdoors.
- Printed to order.
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included.

Production and listing disclosure
This listing and the flag layout were created with AI-assisted layout and listing copy. Production is handled by our production partner, PrintWorks Studio, who prints each flag to order.

Notes for buyers
- This is a printed flag only. If you need a pole or mounting hardware, please add your own or search separately for compatible flagpoles and mounts. Colors may vary slightly by monitor and print run. If you have special placement questions, message us before ordering.
rationale: Scoreboard style and blue palette = bold, high‑contrast visual that reads like a mock-official sports banner; orange accents keep it loud and playful. Eyebrow (LAST PLACE CERTIFIED) functions as a mock official stamp; stacked, all-caps main lines (I SUCK AT / FANTASY / FOOTBALL) maximize legibility at distance and preserve the exact printed phrase.
